Implemented durable Stop -> next-message steering at the interrupted graph model node. Standard Agent preserves planner output; interrupted planners themselves receive the steering input. The service records the continuation choice for command replay. The pipeline validates Chat/Run, frozen context and graph, restores completed values and selected edges, and issues fresh invocations with committed per-node context. Repeated stops and app restart retain the continuation. Normal completion has no continuation and a follow-up begins at workflow entry. Tool results that settle during Stop survive optional compression cancellation; undispatched batch calls receive explicit non-execution results. Approval snapshots now preserve branch edges. A Stop racing final graph bookkeeping does not create a continuation that would ignore the next input.

Critical task.end audit: responsibilities align with updated lifecycle/scheduler/suspension design (revision 626, bindings through 630); no authority bypass, completed effect replay, or cross-Chat mutable continuation state. Older Stop records lacking checkpoints intentionally retain legacy fresh-pass behavior; new stops in existing Chats use the new behavior. No blockers remain.

Validation: cargo check passed. Rust library suite: 354 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored; focused steering tests rerun after final context adjustment: 2 passed. Native debug build passed. Real Windows WebView test with local fixture provider passed all 13 provider requests, covering Agent/planner steering, original plan and tool-result preservation, repeated Stop, app restart, completed follow-up replanning, tool-batch interruption and no undispatched-call execution. Evidence: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-steering-1789717181876/result.json, requests.json and steered-chat.png. Independent native concurrency regression passed all 10 checks, 6 requests: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-concurrency-1789717132767/result.json. git diff --check passed. Existing unrelated Adashi database changes preserved; no commit or merge requested.

data.description: Persist the interrupted graph pass and select it for the next accepted Chat message. Preserve earlier planner output, branch choices, committed per-node context and tool evidence; never automatically replay stopped effects. Use a fresh pass after normal completion. Verify first and repeated Stop, planner and Agent interruption, restart, frozen authority, concurrent Chats and native standard-workflow execution.
data.title: Resume a user-stopped workflow at its interrupted model node
